'''2002 Yavin 4 Regionals''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG regional in April 2002. [[Stephen Turner]] won. [[Kevin Elia]] finished 2nd with a [[Dark]] [[You May Start Your Landing]] list (''2002 Yavin 4 regional 2nd Place- I Am Jacks Anger'').<ref name="dt-22919">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22919 2002 Yavin 4 regional 2nd Place- I Am Jacks Anger], DeckTech (Kevin "KevOfCrofton" Elia, 21 April 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/22919/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/22919/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009215140/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22919/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' April 2002
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Stephen Turner]]
